name: Busa Lesson
description: Lesson-plan generation and compliance-check desk: plan library, compliance checks, and a review queue

agentPrompts.label: What's the state of lesson-plan compliance?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lesson` skill in this folder, then give me the teaching-quality overview — compliance pass rate, coverage by grade and subject, per-teacher status, and what's waiting in the review queue.

agentPrompts.label: Draft a plan and run compliance checks
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lesson` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then draft a lesson plan from the curriculum materials I give you, run the compliance checks, and give me the review-queue link for it.

agentPrompts.label: Import and check a teacher's draft
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lesson` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then parse the teacher's document I give you into a plan (source: teacher_import), run compliance checks, and surface any deficiencies via the checks — do not silently fix their content.

agentPrompts.label: Export the approved plans
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lesson` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then export the plans with status approved or done to Markdown, and tell me the concrete file paths — this never writes back to Busabase.
